omop_sql: SELECT DATE_PART('year', de.drug_era_start_date) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS num_patients FROM synpuf5.drug_era de JOIN synpuf5.concept c ON de.drug_concept_id = c.concept_id WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%aspirin%' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
user_query: How many patients have taken aspirin, year over year?
